payload.campaign: uuid — the campaign whose playbacks stop, or the request's target: one command per playback still playing in the tables (sound_playback.stopped_at null), on its partition SoundPlayback/<its id>, writing its stoppedAt and nothing else, projected into sound_playback.stopped_at; with none playing, one command on SoundPlayback/stop-all-<the campaign>, which names no playback, that writes nothing
payload.session: uuid — optional: only the playbacks of this session of the campaign stop; by default those of every session of the campaign
